pairs: And when he had descended from the mountain,
And behold, a leper, drawing near,
you are able to cleanse me.”
Et confestim mundata est lepra ejus.
And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
“See to it that you tell no one.
But go, show yourself to the priest,
et offer munus, quod præcepit Moyses,
and offer the gift that Moses instructed,
And when he had entered into Capernaum,
puer meus jacet in domo paralyticus,
my servant lies at home paralyzed
non sum dignus ut intres sub tectum meum:
I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof,
and my servant shall be healed.
Nam et ego homo sum sub potestate constitutus,
For I, too, am a man placed under authority,
And he said to those following him:
non inveni tantam fidem in Israël.
I have not found so great a faith in Israel.
quod multi ab oriente et occidente venient,
that many shall come from the east and the west,
and they shall sit at table with Abraham,
and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
filii autem regni ejicientur in tenebras exteriores:
But the sons of the kingdom shall be cast into the outer darkness,
ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
And Jesus said to the centurion,
and just as you have believed,
so let it be done for you.”
Et sanatus est puer in illa hora.
And the servant was healed at that very hour.
Et cum venisset Jesus in domum Petri,
And when Jesus had arrived at the house of Peter,
vidit socrum ejus jacentem, et febricitantem:
he saw his mother-in-law lying ill with a fever.
they brought to him many who had demons,
and he cast out the spirits with a word.
And he healed all those having maladies,
ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam,
in order to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah,
and he carried away our diseases.”
Videns autem Jesus turbas multas circum se,
Then Jesus, seeing the great crowds encircling him,
gave orders to go across the sea.
I will follow you wherever you will go.”
and the birds of the air have nests,
Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet.
but the Son of man has nowhere to rest his head.”
Alius autem de discipulis ejus ait illi:
Then another of his disciples said to him,
et dimitte mortuos sepelire mortuos suos.
and allow the dead to bury their dead.”
et ecce motus magnus factus est in mari,
And behold, a great tempest occurred in the sea,
so much so that the boat was covered with waves;
Et accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus,
And his disciples drew near to him,
Then rising up, he commanded the winds,
For even the winds and the sea obey him.”
Et cum venisset trans fretum in regionem Gerasenorum,
And when he had arrived across the sea, into the region of the Gerasenes,
he was met by two who had demons,
sævi nimis, ita ut nemo posset transire per viam illam.
as they went out from among the tombs, that no one was able to cross by that way.
“What are we to you, O Jesus,
Venisti huc ante tempus torquere nos?
Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
Erat autem non longe ab illis grex multorum porcorum pascens.
Now there was, not far from them, a herd of many swine feeding.
send us into the herd of swine.”
At illi exeuntes abierunt in porcos,
And they, going out, went into the swine.
et ecce impetu abiit totus grex per præceps in mare:
And behold, the entire herd suddenly rushed along a steep place into the sea.
And they died in the waters.
et de eis qui dæmonia habuerant.
and on those who had had the demons.
Et ecce tota civitas exiit obviam Jesu:
And behold, the entire city went out to meet Jesus.
rogabant ut transiret a finibus eorum.
they petitioned him, so that he would cross from their borders.
